a1b2c3d4-0001-4000-8000-000000000009.body: Hover over a region to see its name, then click it. The last cell shows the name of the region you clicked.

a1b2c3d4-0001-4000-8000-000000000010.body: regions adds a circle, a rectangle, and a triangle on top of the image, and payloads gives each one a name.

a1b2c3d4-0001-4000-8000-000000000011.body: auto = false leaves out the image's own cells, so only the regions respond. @bind sel saves a click in sel, while hovering only shows the tooltip and leaves sel as it was.

a1b2c3d4-0001-4000-8000-000000000012.body: sel.cells has one part for each kind of shape: sel.cells.circles for the circle, sel.cells.rects for the rectangle, and sel.cells.polygons for the triangle. Each starts as nothing, and this cell responds when you click a region. After a click, the part's name is the region's name.
